sanskrit_shloka:
सुवर्णाज्जायमानस्य सुवर्णत्वं च शाश्वतम्।
ब्रह्मणो जायमानस्य ब्रह्मत्वं च तथा भवेत्।।51।।
text:
सुवर्णाज्जायमानस्य सुवर्णत्वं च शाश्वतम्।
ब्रह्मणो जायमानस्य ब्रह्मत्वं च तथा भवेत्।।51।।
transliteration:
Suvarṇājjāyamānasya suvarṇatvaṃ ca śāśvatam.
Brahmaṇo jāyamānasya brahmatvaṃ ca tathā bhavet..51..
summary_line: Just as a thing made of gold ever has the nature of gold, so also a being born of Brahman has always the nature of Brahman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
स्वल्पमप्यन्तरं कृत्वा जीवात्मपरमात्मनोः।
योऽवतिष्ठति मूढात्मा भयं तस्याभिभाषितम्।।52।।
text:
स्वल्पमप्यन्तरं कृत्वा जीवात्मपरमात्मनोः।
योऽवतिष्ठति मूढात्मा भयं तस्याभिभाषितम्।।52।।
transliteration:
Svalpamapyantaraṃ kṛtvā jīvātmaparamātmanoḥ.
Yo'vatiṣṭhati mūḍhātmā bhayaṃ tasyābhibhāṣitam..52..
summary_line: Fear is attributed to the ignorant one who rests after making even the slightest distinction between the Jivatman and the Paramatman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
यत्राज्ञानाद्भवेद्द्वैतमितरस्तत्र पश्यति।
आत्मत्वेन यदा सर्वं नेतरस्तत्र चाण्वपि।।53।।
text:
यत्राज्ञानाद्भवेद्द्वैतमितरस्तत्र पश्यति।
आत्मत्वेन यदा सर्वं नेतरस्तत्र चाण्वपि।।53।।
transliteration:
Yatrājñānādbhaveddvaitamitarastatra paśyati.
Ātmatvena yadā sarvaṃ netarastatra cāṇvapi..53..
summary_line: When duality appears through ignorance, one sees another; but when everything becomes identified with the Atman, one does not perceive another even in the least.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: When duality appears through ignorance, one sees another; but when everything becomes identified with the Atman, one does not perceive another even in the least.

sanskrit_shloka:
यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतानि ह्यात्मत्वेन विजानतः।
न वै तस्य भवेन्मोहो न च शोकोऽद्वितीयतः।।54।।
text:
यस्मिन्सर्वाणि भूतानि ह्यात्मत्वेन विजानतः।
न वै तस्य भवेन्मोहो न च शोकोऽद्वितीयतः।।54।।
transliteration:
Yasminsarvāṇi bhūtāni hyātmatvena vijānataḥ.
Na vai tasya bhavenmoho na ca śoko'dvitīyataḥ..54..
summary_line: In that state when one realizes all as identified with the Atman, there arises neither delusion nor sorrow, in consequence of the absence of duality.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: In that state when one realizes all as identified with the Atman, there arises neither delusion nor sorrow, in consequence of the absence of duality.

due to absence of duality (a:absence | dvitīya:duality | taḥ:due to)

sanskrit_shloka:
अयमात्मा हि ब्रह्मैव सर्वात्मकतया स्थितः।
इति निर्धारितं श्रुत्या बृहदारण्यसंस्थया।।55।।
text:
अयमात्मा हि ब्रह्मैव सर्वात्मकतया स्थितः।
इति निर्धारितं श्रुत्या बृहदारण्यसंस्थया।।55।।
transliteration:
Ayamātmā hi brahmaiva sarvātmakatayā sthitaḥ.
Iti nirdhāritaṃ śrutyā bṛhadāraṇyasaṃsthayā..55..
summary_line: The Shruti in the form of the Brihadaranyaka has declared that this Atman, which is the Self of all, is verily Brahman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: The Shruti in the form of the Brihadaranyaka has declared that this Atman, which is the Self of all, is verily Brahman.

sanskrit_shloka:
अनुभूतोऽप्ययं लोको व्यवहारक्षमोऽपि सन्।
असद्रूपो यथा स्वप्न उत्तरक्षणबाधतः।।56।।
text:
अनुभूतोऽप्ययं लोको व्यवहारक्षमोऽपि सन्।
असद्रूपो यथा स्वप्न उत्तरक्षणबाधतः।।56।।
transliteration:
Anubhūto'pyayaṃ loko vyavahārakṣamo'pi san.
Asadrūpo yathā svapna uttarakṣaṇabādhataḥ..56..
summary_line: This world, though an object of our daily experience and serving all practical purposes, is, like the dream world, of the nature of non-existence, inasmuch as it is contradicted the next moment.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: This world, though an object of our daily experience and serving all practical purposes, is, like the dream world, of the nature of non-existence, inasmuch as it is contradicted the next moment.

sanskrit_shloka:
स्वप्नो जागरणेऽलीकः स्वप्नेऽपि न हि जागरः।
द्वयमेव लये नास्ति लयोऽपि ह्युभयोर्न च।।57।।
text:
स्वप्नो जागरणेऽलीकः स्वप्नेऽपि न हि जागरः।
द्वयमेव लये नास्ति लयोऽपि ह्युभयोर्न च।।57।।
transliteration:
Svapno jāgaraṇe'līkaḥ svapne'pi na hi jāgaraḥ.
Dvayameva laye nāsti layo'pi hyubhayorna ca..57..
summary_line: The dream (experience) is unreal in waking, whereas the waking (experience) is absent in dream. Both, however, are non-existent in deep sleep which, again, is not experienced in either.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: The dream (experience) is unreal in waking, whereas the waking (experience) is absent in dream. Both, however, are non-existent in deep sleep which, again, is not experienced in either.

sanskrit_shloka:
त्रयमेवं भवेन्मिथ्या गुणत्रयविनिर्मितम्।
अस्य द्रष्टा गुणातीतो नित्यो ह्येकश्चिदात्मकः।।58।।
text:
त्रयमेवं भवेन्मिथ्या गुणत्रयविनिर्मितम्।
अस्य द्रष्टा गुणातीतो नित्यो ह्येकश्चिदात्मकः।।58।।
transliteration:
Trayamevaṃ bhavenmithyā guṇatrayavinirmitam.
Asya draṣṭā guṇātīto nityo hyekaścidātmakaḥ..58..
summary_line: Thus all the three states are unreal inasmuch as they are the creation of the three Gunas; but their witness (the reality behind them) is, beyond all Gunas, eternal, one, and is Consciousness itself.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
यद्वन्मृदि घटभ्रान्तिं शुक्तौ वा रजतस्थितिम्।
तद्वद्ब्रह्मणि जीवत्वं भ्रान्त्या पश्यति न स्वतः।।59।।
text:
यद्वन्मृदि घटभ्रान्तिं शुक्तौ वा रजतस्थितिम्।
तद्वद्ब्रह्मणि जीवत्वं भ्रान्त्या पश्यति न स्वतः।।59।।
transliteration:
Yadvanmṛdi ghaṭabhrāntiṃ śuktau vā rajatasthitim.
Tadvadbrahmaṇi jīvatvaṃ bhrāntyā paśyati na svataḥ..59..
summary_line: Just as (after the illusion has gone) one is no more deluded to see a jar in earth or silver in the nacre, so does one no more see Jiva in Brahman when the latter is realized (as one's own self).

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
यथा मृदि घटो नाम कनके कुण्डलाभिधा।
शुक्तौ हि रजतख्यातिर्जीवशब्दस्तथा परे।।60।।
text:
यथा मृदि घटो नाम कनके कुण्डलाभिधा।
शुक्तौ हि रजतख्यातिर्जीवशब्दस्तथा परे।।60।।
transliteration:
Yathā mṛdi ghaṭo nāma kanake kuṇḍalābhidhā.
Śuktau hi rajatakhyātirjīvaśabdastathā pare..60..
summary_line: Just as earth is described as a jar, gold as an ear-ring, and a nacre as silver, so is Brahman described as Jiva.

translations.author: Traditional Translation

sanskrit_shloka:
यथैव व्योम्नि नीलत्वं यथा नीरं मरुस्थले।
पुरुषत्वं यथा स्थाणौ तद्वद्विश्वं चिदात्मनि।।61।।
text:
यथैव व्योम्नि नीलत्वं यथा नीरं मरुस्थले।
पुरुषत्वं यथा स्थाणौ तद्वद्विश्वं चिदात्मनि।।61।।
transliteration:
Yathaiva vyomni nīlatvaṃ yathā nīraṃ marusthale.
Puruṣatvaṃ yathā sthāṇau tadvadviśvaṃ cidātmani..61..
summary_line: Just as blueness in the sky, water in the mirage, and a human figure in a post (are but illusory), so is the universe in Atman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: Just as blueness in the sky, water in the mirage, and a human figure in a post (are but illusory), so is the universe in Atman.

sanskrit_shloka:
यथैव शून्ये वेतालो गन्धर्वाणां पुरं यथा।
यथाकाशे द्विचन्द्रत्वं तद्वत्सत्ये जगत्स्थितिः।।62।।
text:
यथैव शून्ये वेतालो गन्धर्वाणां पुरं यथा।
यथाकाशे द्विचन्द्रत्वं तद्वत्सत्ये जगत्स्थितिः।।62।।
transliteration:
Yathaiva śūnye vetālo gandharvāṇāṃ puraṃ yathā.
Yathākāśe dvicandratvaṃ tadvatsatye jagatsthitiḥ..62..
summary_line: Just as the appearance of a ghost in an empty place, of a castle in the air, and of a second moon in the sky (is illusory), so is the appearance of the universe in Brahman.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: Just as the appearance of a ghost in an empty place, of a castle in the air, and of a second moon in the sky (is illusory), so is the appearance of the universe in Brahman.

sanskrit_shloka:
यथा तरङ्गकल्लोलैर्जलमेव स्फुरत्यलम्।
पात्ररूपेण ताम्रं हि ब्रह्माण्डौघैस्तथात्मता।।63।।
text:
यथा तरङ्गकल्लोलैर्जलमेव स्फुरत्यलम्।
पात्ररूपेण ताम्रं हि ब्रह्माण्डौघैस्तथात्मता।।63।।
transliteration:
Yathā taraṅgakallolairjalameva sphuratyalam.
Pātrarūpeṇa tāmraṃ hi brahmāṇḍaughaistathātmatā..63..
summary_line: Just as it is water that appears as ripples and waves, or again it is copper, that appears in the form of vessel so it is Atman that appears as the whole universe.

translations.author: Traditional Translation
translations.text: Just as it is water that appears as ripples and waves, or again it is copper, that appears in the form of vessel so it is Atman that appears as the whole universe.

sanskrit_shloka:
घटनाम्ना यथा पृथ्वी पटनाम्ना हि तन्तवः।
जगन्नाम्ना चिदाभाति ज्ञेयं तत्तदभावतः।।64।।
text:
घटनाम्ना यथा पृथ्वी पटनाम्ना हि तन्तवः।
जगन्नाम्ना चिदाभाति ज्ञेयं तत्तदभावतः।।64।।
transliteration:
Ghaṭanāmnā yathā pṛthvī paṭanāmnā hi tantavaḥ.
Jagannāmnā cidābhāti jñeyaṃ tattadabhāvataḥ..64..
summary_line: Just as it is earth that appears under the name of a jar, or it is threads that appear under the name of a cloth, so it is Atman that appears under the name of the universe. This Atman is to be known by negating the names.

sanskrit_shloka:
सर्वोऽपि व्यवहारस्तु ब्रह्मणा क्रियते जनैः।
अज्ञानान्न विजानन्ति मृदेव हि घटादिकम्।।65।।
text:
सर्वोऽपि व्यवहारस्तु ब्रह्मणा क्रियते जनैः।
अज्ञानान्न विजानन्ति मृदेव हि घटादिकम्।।65।।
transliteration:
Sarvo'pi vyavahārastu brahmaṇā kriyate janaiḥ.
Ajñānānna vijānanti mṛdeva hi ghaṭādikam..65..
summary_line: People perform all their actions in and through Brahman, (but on account of ignorance they are not aware of that), just as through ignorance persons do not know that jars and other earthenwares are nothing but earth.

sanskrit_shloka:
कार्यकारणता नित्यमास्ते घटमृदोर्यथा।
तथैव श्रुतियुक्तिभ्यां प्रपञ्चब्रह्मणोरिह।।66।।

कार्यकारणता नित्यमास्ते घटमृदोर्यथा।
तथैव श्रुतियुक्तिभ्यां प्रपञ्चब्रह्मणोरिह।।66।।

Kāryakāraṇatā nityamāste ghaṭamṛdoryathā.
Tathaiva śrutiyuktibhyāṃ prapañcabrahmaṇoriha..66..

sanskrit_shloka:
गृह्यमाणे घटे यद्वन्मृत्तिका भाति वै बलात्।
वीक्ष्यमाणे प्रपञ्चेऽपि ब्रह्मैवाभाति भासुरम्।।67।।
text:
गृह्यमाणे घटे यद्वन्मृत्तिका भाति वै बलात्।
वीक्ष्यमाणे प्रपञ्चेऽपि ब्रह्मैवाभाति भासुरम्।।67।।
transliteration:
Gṛhyamāṇe ghaṭe yadvanmṛttikā bhāti vai balāt.
Vīkṣyamāṇe prapañce'pi brahmaivābhāti bhāsuram..67..
summary_line: Just as (the consciousness of) earth forces itself upon our mind while thinking of a jar, so also does (the idea of) ever-shining Brahman flash on us while contemplating on the phenomenal world.

देहादीनामसत्यत्वाद्यथा स्वप्नः प्रबोधतः।।91।।
text:
तत्त्वज्ञानोदयादूर्ध्वं प्रारब्धं नैव विद्यते।

Tattvajñānodayādūrdhvaṃ prārabdhaṃ naiva vidyate.

summary_line: After the origination of the knowledge of Reality, Prarabdha verily ceases to exist, inasmuch as the body and the like become non-existent; just as a dream does not exist on waking.

sanskrit_shloka:
कर्म जन्मान्तरकृतं प्रारब्धमिति कीर्तितम्।
तत्तु जन्मान्तराभावात्पुंसो नैवास्ति कर्हिचित्।।92।।
text:
कर्म जन्मान्तरकृतं प्रारब्धमिति कीर्तितम्।
तत्तु जन्मान्तराभावात्पुंसो नैवास्ति कर्हिचित्।।92।।
transliteration:
Karma janmāntarakṛtaṃ prārabdhamiti kīrtitam.
Tattu janmāntarābhāvātpuṃso naivāsti karhicit..92..
summary_line: That Karma which is done in a previous life is known as Prarabdha (which produces the present life). But such Karma cannot take the place of Prarabdha (for a man of knowledge), as he has no other birth (being free from ego).

sanskrit_shloka:
स्वप्नदेहो यथाध्यस्तस्तथैवायं हि देहकः।।
अध्यस्तस्य कुतो जन्म जन्माभावे स्थितिः कुतः।।93।।
text:
स्वप्नदेहो यथाध्यस्तस्तथैवायं हि देहकः।।
अध्यस्तस्य कुतो जन्म जन्माभावे स्थितिः कुतः।।93।।
transliteration:
Svapnadeho yathādhyastastathaivāyaṃ hi dehakaḥ..
Adhyastasya kuto janma janmābhāve sthitiḥ kutaḥ..93..
summary_line: Just as the body in a dream is superimposed (and therefore illusory), so is also this body. How could there be any birth of the superimposed (body), and in the absence of birth (of the body) where is the room for that (i.e., Prarabdha) at all ?

sanskrit_shloka:
उपादानं प्रपञ्चस्य मृद्भाण्डस्येव कथ्यते।
अज्ञानं चैव वेदान्तैस्तस्मिन्नष्टे क्व विश्वता।।94।।

sanskrit_shloka:
यथा रज्जुं परित्यज्य सर्प गृह्णाति वै भ्रमात्।
तद्वत्सत्यमविज्ञाय जगत्पश्यति मूढधीः।।95।।
text:
यथा रज्जुं परित्यज्य सर्प गृह्णाति वै भ्रमात्।

Yathā rajjuṃ parityajya sarpa gṛhṇāti vai bhramāt.
Tadvatsatyamavijñāya jagatpaśyati mūḍhadhīḥ..95..

अधिष्ठाने तथा ज्ञाते प्रपञ्चः शून्यतां व्रजेत्।।96।।
text:
रज्जुरूपे परिज्ञाते सर्पभ्रान्तिर्न तिष्ठति।

Adhiṣṭhāne tathā jñāte prapañcaḥ śūnyatāṃ vrajet..96..

अज्ञानिजनबोधार्थं प्रारब्धं वक्ति वै श्रुतिः।।97।।

बहुत्वं तन्निषेधार्थं श्रुत्या गीतं च वै स्फुटम्।।98।।
